title: Local surjectivity of the concrete underlying-set Kan comparison
statement: Let X and T be schemes in universe u+1, p:T → X, H a left adjoint to the actual abelian small-etale pushforward along p with specified adjunction hH, and F an abelian sheaf with carriers in Type (u+1) [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Lift the underlying presheaf of F to Type (u+2), and let P be its pointwise left Kan extension along p.Etale.op (the pointwise colimit over pairs of an etale X-object and a map from the test object into its base change). Let q:P → ULift(H(F)) be the unique natural transformation whose composite with the Kan unit is the lifted supplied adjunction unit. Then q is locally surjective on the small-etale topology of T [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]: for every etale object Z and every lifted section t of H(F)(Z), the sieve of arrows on which t lifts through q is covering. This asserts no explicit representatives of elements of P and no small indexed cover.

source.place: Proposition 7.44.3, abelian inverse image compatible with underlying sets; Tag 09XN, local representatives; Sites Tag 00WK, local surjectivity of sheafification; Tag 04HR, affine cover-dense etale site

proof.text: Prove finite-limit preservation of the large set inverse image by composing the inclusion, the opposite-base-change Kan extension, and sheafification. Base change is representably flat; AB5OfSize_of_univLE provides the appropriate exact filtered colimits of types. Apply etaleInverseImageAbelianLift_hom to obtain the large abelian/set comparison ea and its hom-set equation. No ring operations are needed.

For each small abelian sheaf G, apply Scheme.etale_setPullback_small to its underlying small set sheaf. The comparison ea injects each section group of the large abelian inverse image of ULift(G) into this small set. Thus each section group is small. Construct a small abelian presheaf using Shrink and transport every restriction map with Shrink.addEquiv. The resulting lifted presheaf is isomorphic to the original large abelian sheaf; reflection of the sheaf condition gives a small abelian sheaf. This is the private proved helper smallAbelianSheaf_essImage. Consequently the lifted large inverse-image functor takes values in the essential image of the fully faithful coefficient ULift functor.

Use Functor.essImage.liftFunctor to restrict the large abelian inverse image to small abelian sheaves, with its canonical comparison e. Restrict the large adjunction along the fully faithful coefficient ULift functors; right pushforward commutes definitionally with ULift. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq compares this restricted left adjoint L with the supplied H. Compose ea inverse, e inverse and this adjoint comparison to obtain the underlying-set sheaf isomorphism d from the large set inverse image to ULift(H(F)). The large hom-set compatibility, map_restrictFullyFaithful_unit_app and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app prove that d carries the large set unit to the lifted supplied unit.

Expand the unit of the constructed set adjunction as the Kan unit followed by the whiskered sheafification unit; this is the private proved helper etaleSetPullback_unit_hom, using Adjunction.map_restrictFullyFaithful_unit_app and Adjunction.comp_unit_app. The preceding unit equality and Functor.leftKanExtension_hom_ext identify the given concrete Kan comparison with toSheafify followed by d.hom.hom. Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_toSheafify' supplies local surjectivity of the set sheafification unit; the underlying map of d is an isomorphism, hence locally surjective. Composition proves the conclusion. This includes empty objects automatically and does not choose explicit covering families.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleAbelianKanComparison_locally_surjective
    {X T : Scheme.{u + 1}} (p : T ⟶ X)
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤
      Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology T.smallEtaleTopology)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective T.smallEtaleTopology
      (etaleAbelianKanComparison p H hH F)
